metadata.description: Kabo official plugin marketplace: clients (Claude Code / Codex) for the creator-focused Skill distribution platform. The server and the skill sources are not in this repo.

plugins.name: kabo-alpha
plugins.description: Kabo client plugin: skill search/download/verification, skill-runner execution orchestration, dynamic meta-guidance (injected after Ed25519 signature verification). Usage telemetry is limited to event-level metadata (which skill ran and whether it succeeded); no prompt, tool or skill-output content is collected.
